gaps.sentence: They've just moved ___ to their new flat.
gaps.explanation: move in = start living in a new home.

gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The negotiators refused to give ___ to the hijackers' demands.
gaps.explanation: give in (to) = stop arguing and accept; give up = quit.

gaps.sentence: The evidence finally backed ___ his version of events.
gaps.explanation: back up = support with evidence (a claim backs up a story).

gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.

gaps.sentence: Put ___ your coat — it's freezing outside.
gaps.explanation: put on = dress in; put off = postpone.
